calibration_sources: BIRD-SQL & Spider 2.0 Enterprise Text-to-SQL Benchmarks (CHESS / DAIL-SQL / MAC-SQL Value Linking & Column Pruning)
dbt MetricFlow / Cube Semantic Layer & Microsoft Fabric IQ Ontology Grounded NL2DSL Evaluations
SQLGlot AST Validation & Read-Only EXPLAIN Plan Self-Correction Loop Studies

workload.warehouse_scale: Enterprise Snowflake / Databricks / Fabric Data Warehouse (800 Tables, 18,000 Columns, 95,000 Raw DDL Tokens)
workload.query_benchmark: 1,000 Enterprise BI & Analytics Queries (65% Governed KPI/Metric Aggregations + 35% Ad-Hoc Multi-Join Exploratory Queries, BIRD / Spider-2.0 Enterprise profile)
workload.critical_risk: Silent KPI formula drift (e.g., forgetting to exclude refunded/test orders in NRR) is far more dangerous than a syntax error

tiers.name: Tier 1: 全量 800 张表 DDL 硬塞直出 SQL (95K 词注意力迷失 -> 38.5% 准确率 + 28.4% 口径漂移)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Full-Schema 800-Table DDL Stuffing + 1-Shot Raw SQL (38.5% EX & 28.4% KPI Drift)
tiers.schema_and_execution_stack: Dumps all 800 CREATE TABLE DDLs (95K tokens) into context + single-pass raw SQL generation
tiers.value_and_metric_governance: Zero cell-value lookup; LLM invents ad-hoc JOIN paths and inconsistent KPI formulas
tiers.recommended_for: Tiny <=10-table toy databases only; unusable on enterprise warehouses due to JOIN hallucinations and $289/1k cost.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 向量检索 Top-15 表 DDL + 少样本示例 RAG (漏检脏枚举值 'CA' vs 'California' -> 空结果)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Vector Top-15 Table DDL RAG + Few-Shot SQL Examples (58.2% EX · Misses Cell Values)
tiers.schema_and_execution_stack: Dense vector retrieval of Top-15 tables + Top-5 historical SQL pairs (12.4K tokens)
tiers.value_and_metric_governance: No LSH cell-value index (writes WHERE status='Completed' when DB stores 'COMP_01') & 16.5% KPI drift
tiers.recommended_for: Simple internal staging tables with clean human-readable column enums and no strict financial KPIs.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 列级精排裁剪 + MinHash LSH 单元格值倒排链接 + 沙箱 EXPLAIN 自纠错循环 (CHESS/DAIL 范式)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Column Pruning + LSH Cell-Value Linking + Read-Only EXPLAIN Self-Correction (78.6% EX)
tiers.schema_and_execution_stack: Prunes to Top-60 columns + MinHash LSH maps user entities to exact DB enum strings + 2-turn EXPLAIN Dry-Run
tiers.value_and_metric_governance: Eliminates empty WHERE clauses and syntax errors, but still suffers 9.2% business metric drift on raw tables
tiers.recommended_for: Ad-hoc data science exploration over raw tables without pre-defined semantic metrics.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 声明式受管语义层 (Cube/MetricFlow/Fabric IQ) + LSH 值链接双轨路由 (91.4% 准确率 · 0.8% 漂移)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Governed Semantic Layer (MetricFlow/Cube DSL) + LSH Value-Linked SQL Router (91.4% EX)
tiers.schema_and_execution_stack: Routes 65% KPI queries to deterministic Semantic Layer DSL (pre-verified JOINs/filters) + 35% ad-hoc to Tier 3 LSH+EXPLAIN
tiers.value_and_metric_governance: Compiler-guaranteed JOIN paths & audited KPI formulas + LSH exact enum matching + SQLGlot AST guardrails
tiers.recommended_for: Production enterprise BI Copilots, CFO/board reporting, and 500+ table data warehouses requiring >90% accuracy and zero KPI drift.
